嘴唇不说诡诈的话；
For
“He who would love life
and see good days
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.

願享美福，須要禁止舌頭不出惡言，
嘴唇不說詭詐的話；
For
“He who would love life
and see good days
let him keep his tongue from evil
and his lips from speaking deceit.

Let the man who has a love of life
